topic: Deep learning QPE with satellite input

search_window.note: One April 2023 GRL paper is kept as near-boundary because it is highly relevant and foundational for satellite passive-microwave DL-QPE.

papers.title: Deep Learning for Precipitation Retrievals Using ABI and GLM Measurements on the GOES-R Series
papers.venue: IEEE Transactions on Geoscience and Remote Sensing
papers.satellite_input: GOES-R ABI multi-channel brightness temperatures and GLM lightning flash rate
papers.method: Two CNNs for precipitation detection and quantitative retrieval
papers.task: near-real-time satellite precipitation retrieval / RRQPE improvement
papers.key_reason: Directly targets operational GOES rainfall-rate QPE and demonstrates the value of adding lightning observations to ABI IR inputs.

papers.title: A deep learning-based framework for multi-source precipitation fusion
papers.satellite_input: remote-sensing precipitation products combined with other precipitation sources
papers.target_or_reference: in situ and multi-source precipitation references
papers.task: multi-source precipitation downscaling and fusion for QPE
papers.key_reason: A strong RSE paper framing QPE as spatiotemporal fusion rather than only single-sensor retrieval.

papers.title: Multi-Task Learning for Simultaneous Retrievals of Passive Microwave Precipitation Estimates and Rain/No-Rain Classification
papers.method: physics-guided multi-task neural network for rain/no-rain and rain-rate retrieval
papers.key_reason: Published just before the strict 2023-05-28 window, but central to DL-based satellite precipitation retrieval.

papers.title: TRMM-era neural networks for GPM-era satellite quantitative precipitation estimation (QPE)
papers.method: comparison of legacy FORTRAN neural network and TensorFlow neural network
papers.key_reason: Useful counterpoint: operational simplicity can matter as much as architectural novelty in hydrometeorological retrievals.

papers.title: Bias Correction of Satellite Precipitation Estimation Using Deep Neural Networks and Topographic Information Over the Western U.S.
papers.satellite_input: PDIR-Now / PERSIANN dynamic infrared rain-rate product
papers.target_or_reference: regional precipitation reference and topographic information
papers.method: U-Net, Efficient-UNet, and conditional GAN bias correction
papers.task: satellite precipitation bias correction in complex terrain
papers.key_reason: Directly addresses orographic bias in satellite QPE with modern image-to-image deep networks.

papers.title: Probabilistic Near-Real-Time Retrievals of Rain Over Africa Using Deep Learning
papers.target_or_reference: GPM calibration satellite labels; comparison with IMERG and CHIRPS
papers.task: probabilistic near-real-time precipitation retrieval over Africa
papers.key_reason: One of the clearest recent examples of probabilistic satellite QPE with operational latency constraints.

papers.title: PERSIANN-Unet: A Global Deep Learning Framework for Near-Real-Time Precipitation Estimation Using Infrared Data
papers.satellite_input: global geostationary infrared imagery plus monthly climatology
papers.target_or_reference: IMERG Final and Stage IV evaluation
papers.key_reason: Represents the modern deep-learning update of the PERSIANN family for global IR-based QPE.

papers.title: HR-PrecipNet: A machine learning framework for 1-km high-resolution satellite precipitation estimation
papers.satellite_input: infrared, water vapor, satellite soil moisture and auxiliary geospatial variables
papers.method: U-Net variants followed by random-forest refinement
papers.key_reason: Strong example of DL-based high-resolution QPE/downscaling using satellite channels and land-surface information.

papers.title: An unsupervised adaptive fusion framework for satellite-based precipitation estimation without gauge observations
papers.satellite_input: IMERG-Early and SM2RAIN satellite-related precipitation sources
papers.target_or_reference: unsupervised objective; gauge data used for validation
papers.method: adaptive fusion network optimized without gauge observations
papers.task: satellite precipitation fusion in ungauged regions
papers.key_reason: Important for sparse-gauge or ungauged QPE, where supervised station correction is not feasible.

papers.title: A multi-task deep learning model for bias correction and merging of precipitation data in the Lancang-Mekong River Basin
papers.target_or_reference: ground gauge data; ERA5 as additional source
papers.method: multi-task U-Net with precipitation mask and intensity reconstruction branches
papers.task: bias correction and merging of satellite precipitation products
papers.key_reason: Shows how classification-regression multi-task design can improve regional satellite QPE fusion.

papers.title: A plug-and-play generative framework for multi-satellite precipitation estimation
papers.satellite_input: multi-satellite modalities with sensor-specific conditional branches
papers.method: latent generative framework with plug-and-play sensor conditioning
papers.key_reason: Promising direction for modular multi-sensor QPE where new sensors can be added without retraining the whole model.

papers.title: Oya: Deep Learning for Accurate Global Precipitation Estimation
papers.satellite_input: full-spectrum VIS-IR observations from geostationary satellites
papers.method: two-stage U-Net for precipitation detection and QPE
papers.key_reason: Strong modern global QPE framing with explicit detection-then-regression handling of rain/no-rain imbalance.

papers.title: Huayu: Advanced Real-Time Precipitation Estimation from Geostationary Satellite
papers.target_or_reference: IMERG Final and rain gauge comparison
papers.method: machine-learning real-time satellite precipitation retrieval system
papers.key_reason: Important China/East-Asia GEO satellite QPE system with high temporal and spatial resolution.

papers.title: Data-driven Precipitation Nowcasting Using Satellite Imagery
papers.satellite_input: geostationary satellite infrared and water-vapor imagery
papers.method: Neural Precipitation Model with positional encoders
papers.task: precipitation nowcasting up to six hours
papers.key_reason: Top-conference satellite precipitation paper, but it is QPF/nowcasting rather than strict QPE.
